entries.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
entries.answer: Success means the roadmap names at least three future releases grounded in current primary-source AI trends, every implemented structural rule in validate-qif.mjs and validate-expert-judgment.mjs has a retained negative fixture or explicit justified rescope, npm test is green with drift checking, AOF v10.8.0 planning/review/verification evidence is green, and the exact verified commit is published as QIF v0.4.3 on ai-org-labs.
entries.expectation_state: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation

entries.question: need validation で何が確定したか
entries.answer: The nearest accepted release target is v0.4.3. New agentic features are deferred until the core verifier claims are regression-proven; the roadmap is updated now so later slices address current and next-wave agent quality risks in order.

entries.question: framework self-audit で次に残る gap は何か
entries.answer: Discovery-session, organizational-quality-culture, evaluation-target, and review-run verifier branches do not yet have complete retained negative fixture coverage; empirical outcome calibration remains unproven.
entries.expectation_state: The two core package verifiers now have complete retained error-branch fixture coverage, AOF v10.8.0 review and verification passed, and exact-SHA v0.4.3 is public.
entries.mismatch_state: Discovery-session, organizational-quality-culture, evaluation-target, and review-run verifier branches do not yet have complete retained negative fixture coverage; empirical outcome calibration remains unproven.
entries.scale_direction: Implement v0.4.4 runtime package fixture coverage without importing v0.5 ledger semantics early.
